metadata.title: Lo-Fi Analog Portrait with Arched Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-grain, low-light portrait of a man in profile smoking a cigarette, positioned in the bottom right corner against a vast, textured black void, with arched, hand-drawn-style red lettering in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject anchored to the bottom right corner
Typography mirroring the curve of the subject's head
Extreme contrast between the dark void and the lit face
Heavy film grain unifying text and image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is in the bottom right quadrant, occupying approximately 25% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lit cigarette and the subject's face act as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright cigarette, move up the face, and follow the arch of the text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space occupies the entire left and top-center regions.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black with heavy monochromatic noise.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and bright white of the cigarette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, black, and muted red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif with irregular, rounded edges.
letterConstructionRules: Letters follow a convex upward arch
Variable baseline heights for a hand-cut look
Thick, blocky strokes with soft corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have a slight 'sticker' or 'cut-out' appearance with a thin dark outline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-weight display lettering to maintain minimalist focus.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar blocky, playful weight but requires manual arching and distressing.
Best matches the organic, slightly irregular feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, low-light analog photo of a man in profile smoking a cigarette, positioned in the bottom right corner. The background should be a solid, textured black void with heavy film noise.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched, hand-drawn bold red uppercase text in the upper right quadrant. Apply a grain filter and a slight dark stroke to the text to blend it with the background noise.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across text and image?
Is the subject strictly in the bottom right corner?
Is the background a deep, noisy black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cigarette ember is the brightest point.
Check that the text does not look like a standard system font.
Verify the profile view is clear despite the grain.
Confirm the black background is not a flat hex color but has texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile subject in [Corner] + [Heavy Grain] + [Arched Hand-Drawn Text] in [Opposite Corner] + [Dark Void Background]
